:::{#sol-epe-three-sources}

1. The [expected squared prediction error](#def-epe) is the sum of the three sources:
   $1 + 2 + 3 = 6$.

2. $0 + 0 + 3 = 3$.
   The noise variance $\varpar = 3$ remains,
   so $3$ is the smallest expected squared prediction error any [prediction](prediction.qmd#def-prediction) can have here.

3. A better method can reduce the squared [bias](#def-prediction-bias) and the variance of $\predvalf{\predvar}$,
   because both depend on how $\fitproc$ is built.
   It cannot reduce $\varpar$,
   which is the variance of the noise $\noise$ in the new outcome.

:::
